text:
Marta: Heads up — courier here with two items for 'June Parker' (visiting for @Sana). One small upright piano, and a wrapped parcel marked FRAGILE (lamp). Can someone confirm pickup/escort?
Frontdesk Bot: Package logged as PRCL-5237. Visitor checked in as 'June Parker'. Temporary badge printed and waiting at desk.
James: I can meet them in ~20m to help move the piano. Do we have a dolly?
Sana: omg that's my grandma 🙈 she said she'll be dropping by right at 3pm. Please save a comfy spot on the couch for her.
Devon: I have a folding dolly in storage 2B and can bring it. Where should we stage the piano? Lobby might block foot traffic.
Marta: Good call — let's hold it in Quiet Room (Rm 402) behind reception. Front desk can escort. Please label the lamp and keep it with the piano until Sana picks up.
Frontdesk Bot: Note: temporary badge for June Parker expires 4pm. Courier has been given visitor pass.
Marta: Also put the lamp in locker A3 (code `4532`) and tag PRCL-5237 as "fragile - keep with piano". Leave a sticky on piano for pickup.
James: On my way with dolly and two boxes of cookies 🍪. I will move both items to Rm 402.
Sana: thank youuu!! tell grandma the cookies are from the office lol. also, can we reserve the couch near the kitchen for her?
Devon: Couch reserved. Piano moved to Rm 402 and lamp secured in A3. Left pic at front desk (posted).
Marta: Amazing — closing this thread once pickup happens. Huge thanks to James and Devon. :thumbsup: 
Sana: Grandmother-approved. ❤️
